title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation (Mask2Former)
mechanism: Mask classification with masked cross-attention restricted to each query's predicted region over a multi-scale pixel decoder; point-sampled mask loss.
evidence: R: SOTA on ADE20K semantic, COCO panoptic/instance at publication; authors state small-object performance is poor.
adaptation: Semantic mode, Swin-B or R50 from ADE20K weights, 512 and 1024 px, grey replicated; target inactive and region classes (splice, material, edge_dark); raise num_points and add dense CE+Dice aux for crack; keep label-safe augmentation.
min_experiment: Arm A M2F Swin-B 512; arm B + dense aux head; 5-fold CV; baseline house; metrics inactive IoU, splice/material/edge_dark IoU, mIoU_rob; kill B if mIoU_rob < house - 0.01 and inactive IoU not above house.
prior_overlap: none; mask-classification decoders listed as never tried. Also proposed as a baseline by D01/D03.

alt_notes.adaptation: Semantic mode, Swin-B or R50 from ADE20K weights, 512 and 1024 px, 1-ch replicated; target inactive and region classes (splice, material, edge_dark); raise num_points, add dense aux head and high-res conv branch for crack.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Same as GOOSE-M2F arms; arm A plain M2F vs house; metric inactive IoU, mIoU_rob, splice IoU; kill A+B if mIoU_rob < house - 0.01 and inactive not above house.
